<artifact_info>
id: art_E7Liy6GI1AIc
type: experiment
title: Inverted Disagreement Asymmetry Test on Sentiment Models
summary: >-
  Comprehensive experiment testing the inverted disagreement asymmetry hypothesis across 720 configurations (3 datasets x
  4 sample sizes x 3 imbalance ratios x 10 seeds x 2 model pairs). The hypothesis predicted that when dissimilar classifiers
  (LR vs RF, NB vs SVM) disagree on sentiment classification, trusting the simpler model when it predicts the minority class
  and the complex model when it predicts the majority class would systematically outperform random guessing. Results DISCONFIRM
  the hypothesis: inverted rule accuracy was 49.0% (near random), identical to the original rule (49.0%) and majority prior
  (49.0%). The confidence-based baseline (54.3%) was the best non-trivial performer. No statistical significance after Benjamini-Hochberg
  correction (mean adjusted p=1.0). Only 10.3% of 652 configurations with disagreements showed raw significance at p<0.05.
  The experiment used matched TF-IDF features, calibrated probabilities via custom Platt scaling, and rigorous statistical
  testing with binomial tests and multiple-comparisons correction. Output includes 8,985 per-example disagreement records
  across all 3 datasets (SST-2, IMDB, Twitter Financial News) with full predictions from both models, the inverted rule, original
  rule, confidence-based selection, always-trust-accurate, and majority prior baselines.

   \"    imbalance_ratio: float,\\\\n\",\n    \"    seed: int,\\\\n\",\n    \") -> Tuple[List[str], List[int]]:\\\\n\",\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\\\n\",\n    \"    Create a subsample with a given class \\\\n\",\n    \"    sampled_idx = sampled_minority + sampled_majority\\\\n\",\n    \"    rng.shuffle(sampled_idx)\\\\n\",\n    \"    \\\\n\",\n    \"    sampled_texts = [texts[i] for i in \\\\n\",\n    \"    sampled_idx = sampled_minority + sampled_majority\\\\n\",\n    \"    rng.shuffle(sampled_idx)\\\\n\",\n    \"    \\\\n\",\n    \"    sampled_texts = [texts[i] for i in    \"    imbalance_ratio: float,\\\\n\",\n    \"    seed: int,\\\\n\",\n    \") -> Tuple[List[str], List[int]]:\\\\n\",\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\\\n\",\n    \"    Create a subsample with a given class imbalance ratio from demo examples.\\\\n\",\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\\\n\",\n    \"    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)\\\\n\",\n    \"    \\\\n\",\n    \"    # Extract texts and labels from demo examples\\\\n\",\n    \"    texts = [ex[\\\"input\\\"] for ex in examples]\\\\n\",\n    \"    labels = [int(ex[\\\"output\\\"]) for ex in examples]\\\\n\",\n    \"    \\\\n\",\n    \"    class_0_idx = [i for i, l in enumerate(labels) if l == 0]\\\\n\",\n    \"    class_1_idx = [i for i, l in enumerate(labels) if l == 1]\\\\n\",\n    \"    \\\\n\",\n    \"    # Determine which is majority\\\\n\",\n    \"    if len(class_0_idx) >= len(class_1_idx):\\\\n\",\n    \"        majority_idx, minority_idx = class_0_idx, class_1_idx\\\\n\",\n    \"    else:\\\\n\",\n    \"        majority_idx, minority_idx = class_1_idx, class_0_idx\\\\n\",\n    \"    \\\\n\",\n    \"    # Calculate target counts\\\\n\",\n    \"    target_minority = max(1, int(round(sample_size / (imbalance_ratio + 1.0))))\\\\n\",\n    \"    target_majority = max(1, sample_size - target_minority)\\\\n\",\n    \"    \\\\n\",\n    \"    # Cap at available\\\\n\",\n    \"    target_minority = min(target_minority, len(minority_idx))\\\\n\",\n    \"    target_majority = min(target_majority, len(majority_idx))\\\\n\",\n    \"    \\\\n\",\n    \"    # Sample\\\\n\",\n    \"    sampled_minority = rng.choice(minority_idx, size=target_minority, replace=False).tolist()\\\\n\",\n    \"    sampled_majority = rng.choice(majority_idx, size=target_majority, replace=False).tolist()\\\\n\",\n    \"    \\\\n\",\n    \"    sampled_idx = sampled_minority + sampled_majority\\\\n\",\n    \"    rng.shuffle(sampled_idx)\\\\n\",\n    \"    \\\\n\",\n    \"    sampled_texts = [texts[i] for i in sampled_idx]\\\\n\",\n    \"    sampled_labels = [labels[i] for i in sampled_idx]\\\\n\",\n    \"    \\\\n\",\n    \"    return sampled_texts, sampled_labels\\\\n\",\n    \"\"\n   ]\n  },\n  {\n \\\\n\",\n    \"    sampled_idx = sampled_minority + sampled_majority\\\\n\",\n    \"    rng.shuffle(sampled_idx)\\\\n\",\n    \"    \\\\n\",\n    \"    sampled_texts = [texts[i] for i in \\\\n\",\n    \"    sampled_idx = sampled_minority + sampled_majority\\\\n\",\n    \"    rng.shuffle(sampled_idx)\\\\n\",\n    \"    \\\\n\",\n    \"    sampled_texts = [texts[i] for i in \\\\n\",\n    \"    sampled_idx = sampled_minority + sampled_majority\\\\n\",\n    \"    rng.shuffle(sampled_idx)\\\\n\",\n    \"    \\\\n\",\n    \"    sampled_texts = [texts[i] for i in \"metadata\": {},\n   \"outputs\": [],\n   \"source\": [\n    \"def create_imbalanced_split_from_demo(\\\\n\",\n    \"    examples: List[Dict[str, Any]],\\\\n\",\n    \"    sample_size: int,\\\\n\",\n    \"    imbalance_ratio: float,\\\\n\",\n    \"    seed: int,\\\\n\",\n    \") -> Tuple[List[str], List[int]]:\\\\n\",\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\\\n\",\n    \"    Create a subsample with a given class imbalance ratio from demo examples.\\\\n\",\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\\\n\",\n    \"    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)\\\\n\",\n    \"    \\\\n\",\n    \"    # Extract texts and labels from demo examples\\\\n\",\n    \"    texts = [ex[\\\"input\\\"] for ex in examples]\\\\n\",\n    \"    labels = [int(ex[\\\"output\\\"]) for ex in examples]\\\\n\",\n    \"    \\\\n\",\n    \"    class_0_idx = [i for i, l in enumerate(labels) if l == 0]\\\\n\",\n    \"    class_1_idx = [i for i, l in enumerate(labels) if l == 1]\\\\n\",\n    \"    \\\\n\",\n    \"    # Determine which is majority\\\\n\",\n    \"    if len(class_0_idx) >= len(class_1_idx):\\\\n\",\n    \"        majority_idx, minority_idx = class_0_idx, class_1_idx\\\\n\",\n    \"    else:\\\\n\",\n    \"        majority_idx, minority_idx = class_1_idx, class_0_idx\\\\n\",\n    \"    \\\\n\",\n    \"    # Calculate target counts\\\\n\",\n    \"    target_minority = max(1, int(round(sample_size / (imbalance_ratio + 1.0))))\\\\n\",\n    \"    target_majority = max(1, sample_size - target_minority)\\\\n\",\n    \"    \\\\n\",\n    \"    # Cap at available\\\\n\",\n    \"    target_minority = min(target_minority, len(minority_idx))\\\\n\",\n    \"    target_majority = min(target_majority, len(majority_idx))\\\\n\",\n    \"    \\\\n\",\n    \"    # Sample\\\\n\",\n    \"    sampled_minority = rng.choice(minority_idx, size=target_minority, replace=False).tolist()\\\\n\",\n    \"    sampled_majority = rng.choice(majority_idx, size=target_majority, replace=False).tolist()\\\\n\",\n    \"    \\\\n\",\n    \"    sampled_idx = sampled_minority + sampled_majority\\\\n\",\n    \"    rng.shuffle(sampled_idx)\\\\n\",\n    \"    \\\\n\",\n    \"    sampled_texts = [texts[i] for i in sampled_idx]\\\\n\",\n    \"    sampled_labels = [labels[i] for i in sampled_idx]\\\\n\",\n    \"    \\\\n\",\n    \"    return sampled_texts, sampled_labels\\\\n\",\n    \"\"\n   ]\n  },\n  {\n \"execution_count\": null,\n   \"metadata\": {},\n   \"outputs\": [],\n   \"source\": [\n    \"def process_configuration_demo(dataset_name: str, examples: List[Dict[str, Any]],\\\\n\",\n    \"                               sample_size: int, imbalance_ratio: float, seed: int,\\\\n\",\n    \"                               model_pair: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:\\\\n\",\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Process a single configuration and return results.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\\\n\",\n    \"    logger.info(f\\\"Processing {dataset_name} | {model_pair} | n={sample_size} | r={imbalance_ratio} | seed={seed}\\\")\\\\n\",\n    \"    \\\\n\",\n    \"    # Create imbalanced split\\\\n\",\n    \"    try:\\\\n\",\n    \"        texts, labels = create_imbalanced_split_from_demo(\\\\n\",\n    \"            examples, sample_size, imbalance_ratio, seed\\\\n\",\n    \"        )\\\\n\",\n    \"    except Exception as e:\\\\n\",\n    \"        logger.error(f\\\"Failed to create imbalanced split: {e}\\\")\\\\n\",\n    \"        return {\\\\n\",\n    \"            \\\"config\\\": {\\\\n\",\n    \"                \\\"dataset\\\": dataset_name,\\\\n\",\n    \"                \\\"sample_size\\\": sample_size,\\\\n\",\n    \"                \\\"imbalance_ratio\\\": imbalance_ratio,\\\\n\",\n    \"                \\\"seed\\\": seed,\\\\n\",\n    \"                \\\"model_pair\\\": model_pair\\\\n\",\n    \"            },\\\\n\",\n    \"            \\\"error\\\": str(e)\\\\n\",\n    \"        }\\\\n\",\n    \"    \\\\n\",\n    \"    # Skip if too few samples\\\\n\",\n    \"    if len(texts) < 2:\\\\n\",\n    \" dataset_name,\\\\n\",\n    \"                \\\"sample_size\\\": sample_size,\\\\n\",\n    \"                \\\"imbalance_ratio\\\": imbalance_ratio,\\\\n\",\n    \"                \\\"seed\\\": }\\\\n\",\n    \"    \\\\n\",\n    \"    # Train/test split\\\\n\",\n    \"    try:\\\\n\",\n    \"        X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(\\\\n\",\n    \"            texts, labels, test_size=0.3, random_state=seed, stratify=labels\\\\n\",\n    \"        )\\\\n\",\n    \"    except ValueError:\\\\n\",\n    \"        # Fallback if stratification fails\\\\n\",\n    \"        X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(\\\\n\",\n    \"            texts, labels, test_size=0.3, random_state=seed\\\\n\",\n    \"        )\\\\n\",\n    \"    \\\\n\",\n    \"    # Build \\\"dataset\\\": dataset_name,\\\\n\",\n    \"                \\\"sample_size\\\": sample_size,\\\\n\",\n    \"                \\\"imbalance_ratio\\\": imbalance_ratio,\\\\n\",\n    \"                \\\"seed\\\": seed,\\\\n\",\n    \"                \\\"model_pair\\\": model_pair\\\\n\",\n    \"            },\\\\n\",\n    \"            \\\"error\\\": f\\\"TF-IDF failed: {e}\\\"\\\\n\",\n    \"        }\\\\n\",\n    \"    \\\\n\",\n    \"    # Get model names\\\\n\",\n    \"    model_a_name = MODEL_A_NAME[model_pair]\\\\n\",\n    \"    model_b_name = MODEL_B_NAME[model_pair]\\\\n\",\n    \" TRAIN_FUNCS[model_b_name](X_train_vec, y_train, seed)\\\\n\",\n    \"    except Exception as e:\\\\n\",\n    \"        logger.error(f\\\"Failed to train models: {e}\\\")\\\\n\",\n    \"        return {\\\\n\",\n    \"            \\\"config\\\": {\\\\n\",\n    \"                \\\"dataset\\\": dataset_name,\\\\n\",\n    \"                \\\"sample_size\\\": sample_size,\\\\n\",\n    \"                \\\"imbalance_ratio\\\": imbalance_ratio,\\\\n\",\n    \"                \\\"seed\\\": seed,\\\\n\",\n    \"                \\\"model_pair\\\": model_pair\\\\n\",\n    \"            },\\\\n\",\n    \"            \\\"error\\\": f\\\"Model training failed: {e}\\\"\\\\n\",\n    \"        }\\\\n\",\n    \"    \\\\n\",\n    \"    # Calibrate models\\\\n\",\n    \"    try:\\\\n\",\n    \"        model_a_cal = calibrate_model_demo(model_a, X_train_vec, y_train, X_val_vec, y_val)\\\\n\",\n    \"        model_b_cal = calibrate_model_demo(model_b, X_train_vec, y_train, X_val_vec, y_val)\\\\n\",\n    \"    except Exception as e:\\\\n\",\n    \"        logger.error(f\\\"Failed to calibrate models: {e}\\\")\\\\n\",\n    \"        # Use uncalibrated models as fallback\\\\n\",\n    \"        model_a_cal = model_a\\\\n\",\n    \"        model_b_cal = model_b\\\\n\",\n    \"    \\\\n\",\n    \"    # Predict\\\\n\",\n\"    try:\\\\n\",\n    \"        # Get predictions and probabilities\\\\n\",\n    \"        pred_a = model_a_cal.predict(X_val_vec)\\\\n\",\n    \"        pred_b = model_b_cal.predict(X_val_vec)\\\\n\",\n    \"        \\\\n\",\n    \"        try:\\\\n\",\n    \"            prob_a = model_a_cal.predict_proba(X_val_vec)[:, 1]\\\\n\",\n    \"            prob_b = model_b_cal.predict_proba(X_val_vec)[:, 1]\\\\n\",\n    \"        except AttributeError:\\\\n\",\n    \"            # For models without predict_proba (like LinearSVC), use decision function\\\\n\",\n    \"            try:\\\\n\",\n    \"                decision_a = model_a_cal.decision_function(X_val_vec)\\\\n\",\n    \"                decision_b = model_b_cal.decision_function(X_val_vec)\\\\n\",\n    \"                # Convert to probabilities using sigmoid\\\\n\",\n    \"                prob_a = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-decision_a))\\\\n\",\n    \"                prob_b = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-decision_b))\\\\n\",\n    \"            except AttributeError:\\\\n\",\n    \"                # Final fallback: use predictions as probabilities\\\\n\",\n    \"                prob_a = pred_a.astype(float)\\\\n\",\n    \"                prob_b = pred_b.astype(float)\\\\n\",\n    \"        \\\\n\",\n    \"        # Get simple vs complex predictions\\\\n\",\n    \"        simple_model_name = SIMPLE_MODEL[model_pair]\\\\n\",\n    \"        complex_model_name = COMPLEX_MODEL[model_pair]\\\\n\",\n    \"        \\\\n\",\n    \"        if simple_model_name == \\\"lr\\\":\\\\n\",\n    \"            simple_pred, simple_prob = pred_a, prob_a\\\\n\",\n    \"            complex_pred, complex_prob = pred_b, prob_b\\\\n\",\n    \"        elif simple_model_name == \\\"nb\\\":\\\\n\",\n    \"            simple_pred, simple_prob = pred_a, \\\\n\",\n    \"    sampled_idx = sampled_minority + sampled_majority\\\\n\",\n    \"    rng.shuffle(sampled_idx)\\\\n\",\n    \"    \\\\n\",\n    \"    sampled_texts = [texts[i] for i in
